PolyChartQA-Test
	

PolyChartQA-Test is the test split of PolyChartQA, a multilingual multimodal benchmark for chart question answering. It evaluates whether vision-language models can understand chart images, read multilingual chart text, ground questions in visual evidence, and perform numerical reasoning across languages.
